description: This file contains unit tests for verifying distributed activity propagation and tracing in an Orleans-based system. It specifically tests how activity context (trace IDs, baggage, trace state) is propagated from clients to grains across different activity ID formats, and configures an Orleans test cluster with activity propagation enabled.

classes.name: ActivityPropagationTests
classes.description: Contains tests to verify activity context propagation in Orleans grains, handling both W3C and Hierarchical activity ID formats.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Sets up an Orleans test cluster with activity propagation enabled, including silo and client configuration.

methods.name: WithoutParentActivity
methods.description: Tests that Orleans creates a new activity when no parent activity exists, for both W3C and Hierarchical formats.

methods.name: WithParentActivity_W3C
methods.description: Verifies that activity context and baggage are correctly propagated in W3C format when a parent activity is present.

methods.name: WithParentActivity_Hierarchical
methods.description: Checks that child activities are properly created with Hierarchical ID format, and baggage is propagated.
